notes.title: Update 04/01/23
notes.content:
Now English localization is polished again!
To make the game compatible for more players, we implemented graphic quality setting:
 - Press ctrl + X + 1/2/3 in game to switch to Low / High / Ultra quaility (Ultra is default)
 - You can also enter the following launch options in the "Properties" menu of the Steam library page of this game: -screen-quality Low / High / Ultra
